questions.question: Which of the following is a malaria parasite?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Plasmodium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Malaria**

 
 
• Microorganisms of the **Plasmodium groups** are responsible for causing **malaria**.
 
• Only **Anopheles mosquitoes **with the infection can** transmit **it through bites.
 
• The parasites in the **mosquito's saliva** are transferred into the victim's blood through the bite.
 
• To mature and reproduce, the parasites travel to the **liver**.
 
• Humans have the ability to contract and spread** five different Plasmodium species**.
 
• ***P. falciparum*** is the most common cause of malaria-related deaths, while* **P. vivax, P. ovale, and P. malariae** *typically cause a less severe form of the disease. 
 
• ***P. knowlesi*** rarely infects humans with disease
 
• **Fever, exhaustion, nausea, and headaches** are among the typical symptoms of malaria.
 
• **Seizures, a coma, or even death** have been known to occur in extreme cases.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Plasmodium**

 
 
• An** obligate parasite **of insects and vertebrates, **Plasmodium is a genus of unicellular eukaryotes**.
 
• In the course of their life cycles, **Plasmodium species develop in blood-feeding insect hosts before injecting parasites into vertebrate hosts during a blood meal**. 
 
• Prior to entering the **bloodstream** to infect red blood cells, parasites develop within a vertebrate body tissue (often the liver).
 
• Malaria may result from the** resulting depletion of host red blood cells**.
 
• In the majority of cases, **mosquitoes feed on blood**, so some parasites picked up during this infection are picked up by them and the life cycle is continued.
 
• The large group of parasitic eukaryotes known as** Apicomplexa** includes Plasmodium.

questions.question: Find the sum of all even natural number less than 85.

Sum = (n[2a+(n-1)d])/(2)

n = number of term

a = first term

d = difference between the first and second number

Number of term = (Last term - First term)/(2)+1

The direct formula for the sum of n even numbers = n(n + 1)

⇒ Second even natural number = 4

⇒ Difference(d) = 4 - 2 = 2

⇒ Last even natural number = 84

⇒ Number of term = (84 - 2)/(2)+1=(82)/(2)+1=41+1=42

According to the question,

⇒ Sum = (n[2a+(n-1)d])/(2)=(42[2×2+(42-1)2])/(2) = 21(4 + 41 x 2) = 21 × 86 = 1806

**Hence, the required sum of even natural numbers is 1806.**

questions.question: In a swimming pool measuring 90 m × 40 m, 150 men take a dip. If the average displacement of water by a man is 8 m³, then what will be the rise in the water level of the pool?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Rise in water level = (**Total Volume Displaced**) ÷ (**Area of Pool Base**)

Total displacement = 150 men × 8 m³ = 1200 m³

Area of pool = 90 m × 40 m = 3600 m²

Rise (h) = 1200 ÷ 3600 = 1/3 m

Rise in cm = (1/3) × 100 = 33.33 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 33.33 cm.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Dimensions of **swimming pool** = 90 m × 40 m

Number of **men** = 150

Average **displacement** per man = 8 m³

**Formula Used:**

Volume of water rose = Total volume displaced by men

Area of base × **Rise in height (h)** = Number of men × Volume displaced per man

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0af9afdb7d2882419098ae00ee3cc0930523eee39286844bd3ff082c5ae3ef63.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total volume of water displaced = 150 × 8 = 1200 m³

⇒ Surface area of the pool = 90 × 40 = 3600 m²

⇒ Let **h** be the rise in water level in meters.

⇒ 3600 × h = 1200

⇒ h = 1200 ÷ 3600

⇒ h = 1/3 m

⇒ To convert meters into **centimeters**, multiply by 100:

⇒ h = (1/3) × 100 cm

⇒ h ≈ 33.33 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 33.33 cm.**

**__Additional Information__**

Archimedes' Principle

The volume of water displaced by a submerged or floating object is exactly equal to the volume of the object itself.

Volume of a Cuboid

The volume of a cuboidal pool is calculated as V = Length × Width × Depth (or height).

Rise in Level Formula

Rise in Level = (Volume Added) ÷ (Area of the Base). This assumes the base area remains constant throughout the rise.

Unit Conversion Rule

__
 
• **Chlorophyll**

 
 
• Chlorophyll is the **pigment **that gives plants their **green color.**
 
• This pigment is necessary in order for plants to make their own food during the process of photosynthesis.
 
• Chlorophyll is referred to as a **photoreceptor.**
 
• Photoreceptors are specially designed proteins that receive and respond to light.
 
• Since chlorophyll is a photoreceptor, it is able to detect light.
 
• When light from the sun hits these photoreceptors, the photoreceptors are able to absorb energy from sun and carry out **photosynthesis**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• It is found in essentially all** eukaryotic cells.**
 
• Its mass is roughly **42 kDa,** with a diameter of **4 to 7 nm.**
 
 
 
• **Carotenoid**
 
 
• **​**Carotenoids are a class of more than **750 **naturally occurring pigments synthesized by plants, algae, and photosynthetic bacteria.
 
• These richly colored molecules are the sources of the yellow, orange, and red colors of many plants.
 
• Fruit and vegetables provide most of the **40 to 50 carotenoids **found in the human diet.
 
 
 
• **Thiamin**
 
 
• Thiamin, or **vitamin B1**, is a water-soluble vitamin found naturally in some foods, added to foods, and sold as a supplement.
 
• Thiamin helps the body generate energy from nutrients.
 
• Thiamin is necessary for the growth, development and function of cells.

• By making its own currency cheaper, the country can boost exports.
 
• At the same time, foreign products become more expensive, so imports fall.
